# Evidence base

Every claim used in the pitch and documentation, with its status and source. Allegations are labeled as such; nothing here is presented as proven unless a court, law or official dataset says so.

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `law` | Statute, regulation or binding decision text. |
| `court` | Judgment or court of accounts decision. |
| `official-data` | Data published by a government body. |
| `audit-finding` | Audit result not finally judged. |
| `estimate` | Estimate by an institution or industry body. |
| `survey` | Self-reported survey. |
| `allegation` | Indictment, investigation or press report; not proven. |
| `field-observation` | Founder's anonymized operational knowledge from a state central purchasing body. |
